# rigvf: IGVF Catalog from R ![rigvf logo](reference/figures/rigvf.png)

*rigvf* provides access the Impact of Genomic Variation on Function
(IGVF) Catalog from within R/Bioconductor, allowing integration with
Bioconductor resources, classes, and methods.

Only limited functionality is currently implemented, mostly centered
around associations among genetic variants, genomic elements, and genes.

## Installation

Install the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/IGVF/rigvf) with:

``` r

## install.packages("BiocManager") # if not installed
BiocManager::install("IGVF/rigvf")
```

## Using `rigvf`

See the [Accessing data from the IGVF
Catalog](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/articles/rigvf.html) vignette for
basic use.

See
[`?catalog_queries`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/catalog_queries.md)
and
[`?db_queries`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/db_queries.md)
for example functions for accessing IGVF data through the Catalog API
and ArangoDB API, respectively.

## Data license

For IGVF Catalog data license, see the [IGVF policy
page](https://data.igvf.org/policies/).

# Package index

## Query IGVF via Catalog API

- [`gene_variants()`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/catalog_queries.md)
  [`variant_genes()`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/catalog_queries.md)
  [`gene_elements()`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/catalog_queries.md)
  [`elements()`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/catalog_queries.md)
  [`element_genes()`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/catalog_queries.md)
  : Query the IGVF Catalog via REST API

## Query IGVF via ArangoDb

- [`db_edges()`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/db_queries.md)
  [`db_nodes()`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/db_queries.md)
  [`db_gene_variants()`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/db_queries.md)
  [`db_gene_elements()`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/db_queries.md)
  : Query the IGVF Catalog via ArangoDB

## Query the IGVF Data Portal

- [`portal_files()`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/portal_queries.md)
  : Query the IGVF Data Portal

## Internal interface functions

- [`arango_request()`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/arango.md)
  [`arango_auth()`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/arango.md)
  [`arango_collections()`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/arango.md)
  [`arango_cursor()`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/arango.md)
  : Internal interface to ArangoDB REST API

## Package configuration

- [`rigvf_config`](https://IGVF.github.io/rigvf/reference/rigvf.md) :
  Package configuration global variable management
